description: In server.rs route_method Email/query for the newsgroup path, jmap.overview_store.query_range(&group_name, lo, hi) loads ALL articles in the group (lo..hi range) into memory as OverviewRecords, then builds EmailOverviewEntry vec, then filters/sorts/paginates in handle_email_query. For a group with 100k articles this loads all 100k records on every Email/query call regardless of the page size requested. The special-mailbox path uses SQL LIMIT/OFFSET to avoid this; the newsgroup path should do similarly.
notes: query_range already has LIMIT MAX_OVER_RESULTS=10000 (bounded). Full JMAP date-sort SQL push-down requires overview store API redesign — defer to v2.
title: Email/query for newsgroup: O(N) articles loaded into memory before filtering
